items.briefing:
Global crime syndicates are rapidly adopting AI tools to run scams at scale, with forecasts suggesting AI-driven fraud could account for up to 90% of all fraud cases by 2028. Australian individuals and organisations should be alert to increasingly convincing phishing emails, fake invoices, and impersonation scams that are now easier and cheaper for criminals to produce in large volumes. Separately, security researchers have identified vulnerabilities in Google's Python AI toolkit that could allow attackers to manipulate AI agent systems — relevant for any Australian teams developing or using AI-powered applications.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected email requesting payment, credentials, or personal information — even if it looks legitimate — verify the request through a separate, trusted channel before acting.

featured.title: Autonomous AI agents could drive 90% of fraud by 2028
featured.quote: AI-driven fraud projected to dominate 90% of scams by 2028, directly threatening Australian businesses and consumers.
